versions.content: EcucChoiceReferenceDef properties With the Ecuc- ChoiceReferenceDef it is possible to define one reference where the destination is specified to be one of several possible kinds. To be able to define such a choice an object of the class EcucChoiceReferenceDef has to be aggregated in a container with the role name reference at the EcucChoiceReferenceDef object. The des- tination s of a EcucChoiceReferenceDef may be EcucParamConfContain- erDef and EcucChoiceContainerDef .
